items.exampleEn: I can't recollect where I parked the car.
items.exampleZh: 我想不起來車子停在哪裡了。

items.exampleEn: The reporter overstepped the limits of good manners.
items.exampleZh: 那位記者的言行超出了禮貌的界限。

items.exampleEn: The horse pranced proudly across the field.
items.exampleZh: 那匹馬昂首騰躍著穿過田野。

items.exampleEn: The little restaurant outshines the expensive hotels in town.
items.exampleZh: 那家小餐廳比鎮上昂貴的飯店還出色。

items.exampleEn: The city planted trees to beautify the old streets.
items.exampleZh: 市政府種樹來美化老街。

items.exampleEn: After playing in the sea, she wrapped her soaking hair in a towel.
items.exampleZh: 在海裡玩完水後，她用毛巾包住濕透的頭髮。

items.exampleEn: The bicycle is my main means of transport.
items.exampleZh: 腳踏車是我主要的交通工具。

items.exampleEn: My teacher asked me to redo my homework.

items.sentenceEn: Bright paintings beautify the walls of the children's hospital.
items.sentenceZh: 色彩明亮的畫美化了兒童醫院的牆面。

items.audioEn: My socks are soaking because I stepped into the pond, so I'll change them before we go in.
items.audioZh: 我踩進池塘，襪子濕透了，所以進去前我要先換掉。

items.sentenceEn: The coach overstepped the mark when he shouted at the referee.
items.sentenceZh: 那位教練對裁判大吼，已經越界了。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather can still recollect the day he met my grandmother.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺到現在還記得他遇見奶奶的那一天。

items.stemEn: At night, the bright new lamps easily ____ the old street lights.
items.stemZh: 晚上，明亮的新路燈輕易就比舊路燈亮得多。

items.stemEn: For many farmers, a small truck is the only ____ of getting crops to market.
items.stemZh: 對許多農夫來說，小貨車是把農作物運到市場的唯一工具。

items.passageEn: Last month I went to my ten-year class reunion at a cozy cafe. At first, I could hardly recollect some of the faces. Then my old best friend arrived, soaking wet from the rain, and we both burst out laughing. We talked about the school talent show, where she had outshone everyone by prancing around the stage in a silly dance. Someone said that if we could redo our school years, we would study less and laugh more. Now that we have a group chat, we finally have an easy means of keeping in touch.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我去參加在一家溫馨咖啡館舉辦的十年同學會。一開始，有些面孔我幾乎想不起來。接著我以前最要好的朋友到了，被雨淋得全身濕透，我們兩個都笑了出來。我們聊起學校的才藝表演，那次她在臺上滑稽地蹦蹦跳跳，比所有人都出色。有人說，如果能重來一次學生時代，我們會少念點書、多笑一點。現在有了群組聊天，我們終於有了方便的方式保持聯絡。

questions.questionZh: 老朋友到的時候是什麼樣子？
options: 穿著和以前一樣的制服

questions.questionZh: 有人說如果能重來，大家會怎麼做？

referenceEn: You overstepped the line when you said that.
By saying that, you have overstepped the line.
rubricZh: 要用 overstep（例如 overstep the line、overstepped the mark）
「這樣說」可寫，例如 when you said that、by saying that 等

items.promptZh: 電腦當機了，所以我得把整份報告重做一遍。
referenceEn: My computer crashed, so I had to redo the whole report.
Because my computer crashed, I had to redo my entire report.
rubricZh: redo 當動詞（例如 had to redo the whole report 等）
「當機」可寫，例如 crashed、stopped working 等
時態配合句意（例如 crashed、has crashed、had to redo、have to redo 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：健康迷思（§11.30）："Take off your soaking clothes before you catch a cold" 隱含「穿濕衣服會感冒」的保健說法；另 soaking 放名詞前通常寫 soaking wet clothes。建議改成中性句，例如 "He came in from the rain with soaking wet hair."。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似不自然："It's soaking outside" 指下大雨不是常見說法（常說 It's pouring），與中譯「外面雨下得很大」對不太上。建議 "We'll get soaking wet if we walk" 之類。
